market.question: Will WTI Crude Oil (WTI) hit (LOW) $95 in May?

assessment.reasoning: WTI front-month around $102-$105, dipping to $95 = -8% to -9% from spot. With high realized vol from Iran/Hormuz uncertainty plus recent -3.9% single-day move, a brief dip to $95 in 26 days is plausible. Moderate-to-likely probability given two-sided volatility.
